Advocate for the Petitioner : Mr F Khan
Advocate for the Respondent : Sc, Revenue
 Before
 Honourable Mr. Justice Kalyan Rai Surana
 Order
Date : 31.05.2023
Heard Mr. F. Khan, learned counsel for the petitioners.

Also heard Ms. G.
Hazarika, learned standing counsel for the respondent no.1, Mr. J. Chutia, learned standing counsel for the KAAC, respondent nos.2, 3 and 7, and Page No.# 7/8 Mr. K. Gogoi, learned Additional Senior Govt. Advocate appearing for respondent no.6.

2. Mr. C. Baruah, learned standing counsel for the respondent nos.4 and 5 has submitted that as per his instructions, the national highway project, in respect of which the petitioner has approached the Court is being carried out by National Highways Infrastructure Development Corporation Ltd.
(NHIDCL), who would be the necessary party in this writ petition and not the respondent nos.4 and 5 as they are not the implementing authority.
3. On the next date, the Court shall consider the prayer of the learned counsel for the respondent Page No.# 1/8 vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 31 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/27502012/
6 nos.4 and 5 for deletion of their names.

entities.text: National Highways Infrastructure Development Corporation Ltd.
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
4. The learned standing counsel for the KAAC has submitted that the nomenclature of respondent no.3 is incorrect and as per his information, the appropriate competent authority would be the Competent Authority for Land Acquisition-cum-Joint Secretary, Department of Revenue, KAAC,
who has been appointed under section 3(a) of the National Highways Act.

5. The learned counsel for the petitioner shall take note of the submissions of learned standing counsel for the respondent nos.4 and 5 and learned standing counsel for the KAAC and take appropriate steps as he may be so advised.
6. Issue notice returnable in 3 (three) weeks.
7. Requisite extra copies of the writ petition be furnished to the learned State and departmental counsel in course of the day, which shall be done after correction of the cause title before the Registrar (Judicial).
Simultaneously, the copy of the writ petition provided to the learned counsel for the respondents shall also be corrected.
Page No.# 8/8 8.
It is submitted that the compensation amount has been deposited with the competent authority of the KAAC and it would be disbursed on verification.

However, it is submitted that in the connected WP(C) 5812/2022, the main prayer of the petitioner is to restrain the Forest Department from entering into the land, which is the subject matter of this writ petition.

In the said connection, the learned standing counsel for the KAAC has submitted that he has a topographical map of the area where the land of the petitioner is situated and as per his instruction, the land falls under the reserve forest of KAAC.
9. Under such circumstances, the KAAC shall file their affidavit-in- opposition positively within 3 (three) weeks.
10. List after 3 (three) weeks.
